headline: Conformational ensembles guiding ligand and allosteric site selection for drug design
label: Molecular Dynamics Conformational Landscapes
summary: Recent work pairs MD-derived ensembles with ligand and allosteric-site selection, tested against binding free energy benchmarks, RNA-ligand docking, and…
synthesis: The dominant thread is structure-based prediction of ligand recognition in which conformational sampling and solvation are varied explicitly rather than static poses taken at face value. Two items rest directly on MD-derived ensembles: an all-atom MD, clustering and ML framework selecting unique conformations for allosteric targeting of collagen-bound MMP1, and an MSM-weighted implicit ligand theory calculation from Folding@Home trajectories ranking 130 SARS-CoV-2 Mpro leads (Pearson R 0.55, RMSE 1.6 kcal/mol). The remaining items supply evaluation and data context: explicit solvent models benchmarked across 92 RNA-ligand complexes, SPIRAL's 1,098 RNA-small molecule structures, MotifLeadDB's scaffold-grouped complexes, and LiraSearch shape and electrostatic matching. What is new is coupling conformational ensembles to ligand and allosteric-site selection, with the RNA and docking benchmarks testing that coupling.
